scope: Kiln's kiln-lattice-dispatch --worker-request transport from this change against the real Lattice db64cd65 binary, every worker the pinned OMP in bubblewrap reaching only a local HTTP 400 endpoint (endpoint.py). No model, provider, forge or remote was contacted. The live scenario was not run.

commands.qualify: qualify.sh run lost_before_start lost_during_run refusals crossed substituted_dispatched cancel
commands.retained_output: $W/k45f-requal/out (copy of /tmp/k45f, 3.1 MB, not committed); qualify.log blake3 dbe24a7e2f2b23667d913756583f9da93558cdcc1b0b5b095416064e2ce41793

run.observed: The prepared request carries dispatch_plan equal to the harness plan digest, the second preparation kept the worker profile, and the observation echoes the plan. Kiln reconciles the single execution; the duplicate reconciles without a second endpoint request.

lost-before-start.observed: Kiln records the closure as no execution instead of reconcile_dispatch. The replay is refused by Kiln before transport because the attempt is settled (implementation_fence_stale).

lost-during-run.observed: SIGKILL of the controller; recovery reconciles the retained result without re-execution, as before.

refusals.observed: kiln-unplanned (the probe request without dispatch_plan) is refused before transport intent. stale-fence is settled before any effect; the replay is refused by Kiln before Lattice runs.

crossed.observed: Lattice recorded another attempt at the same work and fence without a worker (provider allocation unavailable); Kiln's attempt is refused as crossed_attempt with dispatched:false and settled.

kiln_attempt.transport_intent: retained (the second Kiln call ran recover)

substituted-dispatched.observed: Another request's intent executed in the attempt directory. Kiln retains the attempt for reconciliation on dispatch and on recovery and never settles it.

cancel.observed: SIGTERM forwarded as implementation-attempt cancel, as before.

changed: refusals.stale-fence: exit 2 in both; before, the attempt stayed claimed with an unreconciled transport intent; now it is failed/infrastructure with cause lattice_refused_before_effect:stale_fence

lost-before-start.recover: before, not_started_closed_by_recovery was reconciled as an execution (phase executing) and recover-replay exited 0; now the attempt is failed/infrastructure lattice_closed_before_execution with no workflow and the replay is refused (exit 2)
worker requests now carry dispatch_plan; observations echo it
comparison_with_lattice_evidence.unchanged: run, lost-during-run and cancel exits and endpoint request counts

non_claims: No model was called; every worker reached only the local HTTP 400 endpoint, so no candidate was produced
The credential pass-through was exercised by unit tests and a real child process, not by this composed run; every broker here declares credential:null
The Lattice binary is a local release build of the published commit added to the Nix store, not a Nix-built package
The live scenario, Kiln #49 deployment and Kiln #46 independent acceptance remain separate
